trash_description: Release name carries an English/ENG tag outside a subtitle context (ENG SUBS, Sub (Rus, Eng), CHS ENG and similar do not count: Chinese-tagged pairs are subtitle tracks). Title-based on purpose: Radarr/Sonarr also take languages from the indexer, which tags most untagged releases as English, so a Language condition would score the original-language release as a dub.
name: Homelab: English Tag
